The boss shouted and asked whether he is completely out of his mind and ordered to get out of his office.
The boss asked him if he was completely out of his mind and requested him to get out of his office.
answer: The boss shouted at him asking if he was completely out of his mind and ordered him to get out of his office.
explanation: चरण 1: 'shouted' के साथ प्रश्न होने पर 'shouted at him asking if' का प्रयोग बहुत स्वाभाविक है। चरण 2: 'are you' को 'he was' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'Get out...' एक Imperative आदेश है। चरण 4: इसे 'and ordered him to get out' से जोड़ें। 'my' को 'his' में बदलें।
trick: तीव्र भावनाओं वाले वाक्यों में Reporting verb (shouted) को सुरक्षित रखना और प्रश्न के लिए participle (asking) का प्रयोग करना उन्नत शैली है।
tip: Imperative आदेशों को 'ordered to' से जोड़ें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: He said to the committee, 'Let there be a thorough inquiry into this massive financial scam.'
options: He proposed to the committee that let there be a thorough inquiry into that massive financial scam.
He ordered the committee to let there be a thorough inquiry into this massive financial scam.
He suggested to the committee that there should be a thorough inquiry into that massive financial scam.
He advised the committee that there must be a thorough inquiry into this massive financial scam.
answer: He suggested to the committee that there should be a thorough inquiry into that massive financial scam.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let there be...' वाले वाक्यों में सुझाव (Suggestion) का भाव होने पर 'suggested' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 2: इसे 'that there should be' से जोड़ा जाता है। चरण 3: 'this' को 'that' में बदलें। चरण 4: सभी परिवर्तनों को मिलाकर सही विकल्प चुनें।
trick: 'Let there be' को 'to let there be' लिखने के बजाय 'that there should be' में बदलना अधिक औपचारिक और सही माना जाता है।
tip: 'Let there be' को 'that there should be' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: She said, 'I used to play the piano beautifully, but my fingers have grown stiff now.'
options: She said that she used to play the piano beautifully, but her fingers had grown stiff then.
She said that she had used to play the piano beautifully, but her fingers had grown stiff then.
She said that she used to play the piano beautifully, but her fingers have grown stiff now.
She said that she was used to playing the piano beautifully, but her fingers had grown stiff then.
answer: She said that she used to play the piano beautifully, but her fingers had grown stiff then.
explanation: चरण 1: 'used to' (past habit) Indirect Speech में कभी नहीं बदलता है। चरण 2: 'have grown' (Present Perfect) को 'had grown' (Past Perfect) में बदलें। चरण 3: 'my' को 'her' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'now' को 'then' में बदलें।
trick: Past Habit दर्शाने वाले Modals (used to, ought to) अपना रूप नहीं बदलते हैं। 'now' को 'then' में बदलना अनिवार्य है।
tip: 'used to' (Past Habit) का रूप Indirect में नहीं बदलता।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Curse the unpredictable weather!' the captain muttered. 'It will definitely delay our departure.'
options: The captain cursed the unpredictable weather and muttered that it would definitely delay their departure.
The captain muttered a curse on the unpredictable weather and said that it will definitely delay our departure.
The captain exclaimed with a curse at the unpredictable weather and said it would definitely delay his departure.
Both A and C are grammatically acceptable, successfully transforming the exclamation.
answer: Both A and C are grammatically acceptable, successfully transforming the exclamation.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Curse the...' को 'cursed' (Reporting verb) में बदला जा सकता है (The captain cursed the weather)। चरण 2: या इसे 'exclaimed with a curse' के रूप में भी लिखा जा सकता है। चरण 3: 'will' को 'would' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'our' को 'their' या 'his' (संदर्भानुसार) में बदलें। दोनों विधियाँ (A और C) सही हैं।
trick: 'Curse' स्वयं एक Transitive Verb बन सकता है (cursed the weather)। यह संरचना वाक्य को अधिक प्रवाहपूर्ण और स्वाभाविक बनाती है।
tip: 'Curse...' को Reporting Verb 'cursed' में सीधे बदला जा सकता है।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The rebel leader said, 'If we strike at dawn, we will catch them completely off guard. Let us prepare our weapons.'
options: The rebel leader said that if they struck at dawn, they would catch them completely off guard, and proposed that they should prepare their weapons.
The rebel leader said that if they strike at dawn, they will catch them completely off guard, and suggested to prepare their weapons.
The rebel leader stated that if they had struck at dawn, they would have caught them completely off guard, and ordered to prepare their weapons.
The rebel leader proposed that if they struck at dawn, they would catch them completely off guard, and let them prepare their weapons.
answer: The rebel leader said that if they struck at dawn, they would catch them completely off guard, and proposed that they should prepare their weapons.
explanation: चरण 1: Condition (If we strike) को 'If they struck' (Past Indefinite) में बदलें। चरण 2: 'will catch' को 'would catch' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'Let us prepare' वाले भाग के लिए 'and proposed that' या 'and suggested that' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: 'they should prepare' में बदलें।
trick: पहला वाक्य Assertive Condition है (said that) और दूसरा Proposal है (proposed that)। दोनों के लिए अलग Reporting verb का प्रयोग जरूरी है।
tip: 'Let us' को हमेशा 'proposed/suggested that they should' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: He said to his friend, 'May God grant you peace! But you must seek forgiveness first.'
options: He prayed that God might grant his friend peace but advised him that he had to seek forgiveness first.
He wished his friend that God may grant him peace but told him that he must seek forgiveness first.
He prayed for his friend that God might grant him peace but advised him that he must seek forgiveness first.
He blessed his friend that God might grant him peace and ordered him to seek forgiveness first.
answer: He prayed for his friend that God might grant him peace but advised him that he must seek forgiveness first.
explanation: चरण 1: 'May God...' Optative वाक्य है, 'said to' को 'prayed' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'May' को 'might' में बदलकर Subject (God) के बाद रखें। चरण 3: 'But you must...' एक सलाह/कर्तव्य है, इसलिए 'advised' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: नैतिक सलाह होने के कारण 'must' नहीं बदलेगा (या had to भी चल सकता है, लेकिन must अधिक उपयुक्त है)।
trick: Optative और Assertive के मिश्रण में, दोनों भागों के लिए अलग-अलग Reporting Verbs (prayed... advised) का प्रयोग करना अनिवार्य है।
tip: Optative वाक्यों में 'prayed/wished that + S + might' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The witness said, 'I swear I did not see the accused at the crime scene that night.'
options: The witness swore that he had not seen the accused at the crime scene that night.
The witness swore that he did not see the accused at the crime scene that night.
The witness promised that he had not seen the accused at the crime scene the previous night.
The witness swore that I had not seen the accused at the crime scene that night.
answer: The witness swore that he had not seen the accused at the crime scene that night.
explanation: चरण 1: 'I swear' को Reporting verb 'swore' में बदल दिया जाता है। चरण 2: 'did not see' (Past Indefinite) को 'had not seen' (Past Perfect) में बदलें। चरण 3: 'I' को 'he' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'that night' पहले से ही Past Time word है, इसलिए यह अपरिवर्तित रहेगा।
trick: 'I swear' कोई Reported Speech का हिस्सा नहीं है, यह Reporting Verb का भाव है। इसलिए इसे 'swore' बनाकर शेष वाक्य का Tense बदलें।
tip: 'I swear' को Reporting Verb 'swore' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'How dare you speak to me like that!' the arrogant king shouted at the minister.
options: The arrogant king shouted at the minister asking how he dared to speak to him like that.
The arrogant king angrily asked the minister how dared he speak to him like that.
The arrogant king shouted at the minister how he dare speak to him like that.
The arrogant king asked the minister how he dared speak to me like that.
answer: The arrogant king shouted at the minister asking how he dared to speak to him like that.
explanation: चरण 1: यह क्रोध दर्शाने वाला प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य है। 'shouted at... asking' का प्रयोग उचित है। चरण 2: 'how' को Conjunction बनाएँ। चरण 3: 'dare' (Present) को 'dared' (Past) में बदलें। चरण 4: वाक्य को Assertive (Subject + Verb) क्रम में रखें: 'how he dared'। 'me' को 'him' में बदलें।
trick: Indirect Question में Inversion (Verb + Subject) का प्रयोग नहीं होता। 'how dared he' गलत है, 'how he dared' सही है।
tip: Indirect Question में हमेशा S + V का क्रम (Assertive) रखें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: She said, 'If I had not missed the bus, I would not be waiting here in the cold.'
options: She said that if she had not missed the bus, she would not be waiting there in the cold.
She said that if she did not miss the bus, she would not be waiting there in the cold.
She said that if she had not missed the bus, she would not have been waiting there in the cold.
She said that if she had not missed the bus, she will not be waiting here in the cold.
answer: She said that if she had not missed the bus, she would not be waiting there in the cold.
explanation: चरण 1: यह Mixed Conditional है (Past cause, Present result)। चरण 2: Unreal Past और Conditionals का Tense Indirect Speech में कभी नहीं बदलता है। चरण 3: 'I' को 'she' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'here' को 'there' में बदलें। वाक्य की संरचना 'if she had not... she would not be' पूर्णतः अपरिवर्तित रहेगी।
trick: Conditionals के Tense को और अधिक Past में नहीं बदला जा सकता। 'here' को 'there' में बदलना न भूलें।
tip: Past Conditionals का Tense Indirect में नहीं बदलता।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The beggar said, 'Let me have a piece of bread, for I am starving to death.'
options: The beggar begged that he might be allowed to have a piece of bread as he was starving to death.
The beggar requested to let him have a piece of bread for he is starving to death.
The beggar proposed to have a piece of bread because he was starving to death.
Both A and B are correct, but A represents a more formal standard of grammar.
answer: The beggar begged that he might be allowed to have a piece of bread as he was starving to death.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let me' + तीव्र आवश्यकता (starving) भीख माँगने (Begging) को दर्शाता है। चरण 2: 'begged that he might be allowed to have' का प्रयोग सबसे औपचारिक और मानक है। चरण 3: 'for' (कंजंक्शन) को 'as' या 'because' में बदल सकते हैं या 'for' ही रख सकते हैं। चरण 4: 'am' को 'was' में बदलें।
trick: 'might be allowed to' संरचना 'Let me' वाले वाक्यों का सबसे औपचारिक और मानक Passive/Indirect रूप है।
tip: 'Let me' को 'that + S + might be allowed to' में बदला जा सकता है।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: He said to me, 'You need not worry about the finances. I have everything under control.'
options: He told me that I did not need to worry about the finances and added that he had everything under control.
He told me that I need not worry about the finances as he had everything under control.
He told me that I would not have to worry about the finances because he has everything under control.
He advised me that I need not have worried about the finances as he had everything under control.
answer: He told me that I need not worry about the finances as he had everything under control.
explanation: चरण 1: जब 'need not' वर्तमान की चिंता/बाध्यता की कमी को दर्शाता है, तो Indirect Speech में यह अपरिवर्तित रहता है। चरण 2: 'have' (Present) को 'had' (Past) में बदलें। चरण 3: Pronouns (You->I, I->he) बदलें। चरण 4: दोनों वाक्यों को 'as' या 'and added that' से जोड़ दें।
trick: वर्तमान की आवश्यकता के लिए 'need not' नहीं बदलता। 'need not have' में बदलना इसे past action बना देगा जो हुआ लेकिन जरूरी नहीं था।
tip: Present obligation में 'need not' को अपरिवर्तित रखें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'What did you find inside the hidden vault?' the detective asked the suspect. 'Nothing but old documents,' he replied.
options: The detective asked the suspect what he had found inside the hidden vault, and he replied that he had found nothing but old documents.
The detective asked the suspect what did he find inside the hidden vault, and he replied nothing but old documents.
The detective asked the suspect what he found inside the hidden vault, and he replied that he found nothing but old documents.
The detective asked the suspect what had he found inside the hidden vault, and he replied that he had found nothing but old documents.
answer: The detective asked the suspect what he had found inside the hidden vault, and he replied that he had found nothing but old documents.
explanation: चरण 1: Wh-question के लिए 'what' को conjunction बनाएँ। चरण 2: 'did you find' (Past Indefinite) को 'he had found' (Past Perfect) में बदलें (Assertive क्रम)। चरण 3: 'Nothing but...' एक अधूरा उत्तर है। Indirect Speech में इसे पूरा किया जाता है (he had found nothing but...) चरण 4: सभी परिवर्तनों को मिलाकर सही विकल्प चुनें।
trick: अधूरे उत्तरों (Elliptical answers) को Indirect Speech में पूर्व संदर्भ के अनुसार पूर्ण वाक्य में बदलना आवश्यक है।
tip: अधूरे उत्तरों को Indirect में पूर्ण वाक्य (Full Clause) बनाएँ।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Do you realize the gravity of your mistake?' the manager asked. 'I do, and I am extremely sorry,' the employee answered.
options: The manager asked the employee if he realized the gravity of his mistake, and the employee replied in the affirmative adding that he was extremely sorry.
The manager asked the employee if he realizes the gravity of his mistake, and the employee replied yes and he was extremely sorry.
The manager asked the employee whether he realized the gravity of his mistake, and the employee answered that he did and is extremely sorry.
The manager enquired if he realized the gravity of his mistake, and the employee replied affirmatively that he did and was extremely sorry.
answer: The manager asked the employee if he realized the gravity of his mistake, and the employee replied in the affirmative adding that he was extremely sorry.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Yes/No' प्रश्न के लिए 'asked if' का प्रयोग करें। 'realize' को 'realized' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'I do' (सकारात्मक उत्तर) के लिए 'replied in the affirmative' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: आगे की बात के लिए 'adding that' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 4: 'am' को 'was' में बदलें।
trick: 'I do' या 'Yes' को 'replied in the affirmative' लिखना सबसे सटीक तरीका है।
tip: सकारात्मक उत्तर (Yes/I do) को 'replied in the affirmative' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The sage said, 'Man proposes, God disposes. Do not be disheartened by failures.'
options: The sage said that man proposes, God disposes, and advised not to be disheartened by failures.
The sage stated that man proposed, God disposed, and advised not to be disheartened by failures.
The sage preached that man proposes, God disposes, and ordered not to be disheartened by failures.
The sage said that man proposes, God disposes, and forbade to be disheartened by failures.
answer: The sage said that man proposes, God disposes, and advised not to be disheartened by failures.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Man proposes, God disposes' एक प्रसिद्ध Proverb (कहावत) है। इसका Tense नहीं बदलेगा। चरण 2: 'Do not be' एक सलाह है। इसे 'advised not to be' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'preached' भी सही है, लेकिन 'ordered' (आदेश) संतों के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है। चरण 4: दोनों भागों को 'and' से जोड़ें।
trick: Proverbs का Tense कभी नहीं बदलता। 'Do not' को 'not to' में बदलना भी अनिवार्य है।
tip: कहावतों (Proverbs) का Tense Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Goodbye, my native land!' the exile cried. 'I shall never see your shores again.'
options: The exile bade goodbye to his native land and cried that he would never see its shores again.
The exile wished his native land goodbye and cried that he should never see its shores again.
The exile exclaimed goodbye to his native land and cried that he will never see your shores again.
The exile bade his native land goodbye and cried that he should never see its shores again.
answer: The exile bade goodbye to his native land and cried that he would never see its shores again.
explanation: चरण 1: विदाई (Goodbye/Farewell) के लिए Reporting verb 'bade' का प्रयोग होता है। चरण 2: 'his native land' को object बनाएँ (bade goodbye to his native land)। चरण 3: दूसरे Assertive वाक्य को 'and cried that' से जोड़ें। चरण 4: 'shall' को 'would' में बदलें (he के साथ would आता है) और 'your' को 'its' में बदलें।
trick: 'Goodbye' के साथ 'bade' का प्रयोग होता है। 'your' यहाँ 'native land' (निर्जीव/देश) के लिए है, इसलिए इसे 'its' में बदला जाएगा।
tip: विदाई वाले शब्दों के लिए 'bade' और देश के लिए 'its' का प्रयोग करें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: She said, 'I came to this city a decade ago, and I have built my entire life here.'
options: She said that she had come to that city a decade before, and she had built her entire life there.
She said that she came to that city a decade ago, and she had built her entire life there.
She said that she had gone to that city a decade ago, and she built her entire life here.
She said that she had come to this city a decade before, and she had built her entire life there.
answer: She said that she had come to that city a decade before, and she had built her entire life there.
explanation: चरण 1: 'came' (Past Indefinite) को 'had come' (Past Perfect) में बदलें। चरण 2: 'this' को 'that' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'ago' को 'before' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'have built' (Present Perfect) को 'had built' में और 'here' को 'there' में बदलें।
trick: सभी Time और Place words (this->that, ago->before, here->there) को बदलना अनिवार्य है। एक भी छूटा तो विकल्प गलत।
tip: Time/Place words (ago, here, this) को Past form में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The captain said to the crew, 'We must abandon the ship immediately, for water is flooding the lower decks rapidly.'
options: The captain ordered the crew that they had to abandon the ship immediately, for water was flooding the lower decks rapidly.
The captain advised the crew that they must abandon the ship immediately, for water was flooding the lower decks rapidly.
The captain told the crew that they must have abandoned the ship immediately, for water was flooding the lower decks rapidly.
The captain ordered the crew to abandon the ship immediately, for water was flooding the lower decks rapidly.
answer: The captain ordered the crew that they had to abandon the ship immediately, for water was flooding the lower decks rapidly.
explanation: चरण 1: 'must' यहाँ तत्काल अनिवार्यता (immediate necessity) दर्शा रहा है, इसलिए इसे 'had to' में बदलना अधिक उपयुक्त है। चरण 2: 'said to' को 'ordered' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'We' को 'they' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'is flooding' (Present Continuous) को 'was flooding' (Past Continuous) में बदलें। (विकल्प D भी सही हो सकता था यदि 'to abandon' का प्रयोग होता, लेकिन 'must' का अर्थ 'had to' में अधिक स्पष्ट है)।
trick: तत्काल अनिवार्यता के लिए 'must' को 'had to' में बदला जाता है।
tip: तत्काल आवश्यकता वाले 'Must' को 'had to' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Let us not deceive ourselves,' the philosopher said. 'The truth is often bitter and hard to swallow.'
options: The philosopher proposed that they should not deceive themselves and added that the truth was often bitter and hard to swallow.
The philosopher suggested not to deceive themselves and said that the truth is often bitter and hard to swallow.
The philosopher proposed that they should not deceive themselves and added that the truth is often bitter and hard to swallow.
The philosopher advised that they should not deceive themselves and added that the truth was often bitter and hard to swallow.
answer: The philosopher proposed that they should not deceive themselves and added that the truth is often bitter and hard to swallow.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let us' को 'proposed that they should' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'ourselves' को 'themselves' में बदलें। चरण 3: दूसरे वाक्य (The truth is...) को 'and added that' से जोड़ें। चरण 4: चूँकि दूसरा वाक्य एक Universal Truth / दार्शनिक तथ्य है, इसका Tense (is) नहीं बदलेगा।
trick: मिश्रित वाक्यों में दूसरे भाग का Tense (is) नहीं बदलना एक बड़ा ट्रैप है क्योंकि वह एक सार्वभौमिक सत्य है।
tip: Universal Truths में Tense का कोई बदलाव नहीं होता।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: He said, 'Need I remind you of your promises every single day?'
options: He asked if he had to remind him of his promises every single day.
He asked if he needed to remind him of his promises every single day.
He asked whether he need remind me of my promises every single day.
He asked if he must remind him of his promises every single day.
answer: He asked if he had to remind him of his promises every single day.
explanation: चरण 1: जब 'Need' का प्रयोग प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य में Auxiliary Verb के रूप में होता है (वर्तमान बाध्यता पूछने के लिए), तो उसे Indirect Speech में 'had to' में बदला जाता है। चरण 2: 'asked if' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: 'I' को 'he' में बदलें। चरण 4: Pronouns (you->him/me, your->his/my) संदर्भानुसार बदलें।
trick: Interrogative 'Need' को 'had to' में बदला जाता है, क्योंकि वह बाध्यता (obligation) पूछता है।
tip: प्रश्नवाचक 'Need' को Indirect में 'had to' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'What an absolute disaster!' the manager exclaimed. 'We have lost our biggest client due to your negligence.'
options: The manager exclaimed with sorrow that it was an absolute disaster and added that they had lost their biggest client due to his negligence.
The manager exclaimed in frustration that it was an absolute disaster and said that we have lost our biggest client due to your negligence.
The manager exclaimed that what an absolute disaster it was and added that they had lost their biggest client due to his negligence.
The manager exclaimed with sorrow that it was an absolute disaster and added that they had lost their biggest client due to my negligence.
answer: The manager exclaimed with sorrow that it was an absolute disaster and added that they had lost their biggest client due to his negligence.
explanation: चरण 1: 'What an...' को 'exclaimed with sorrow/frustration' में बदलें और वाक्य को Assertive (it was an absolute disaster) बनाएँ। चरण 2: दूसरे Assertive वाक्य को जोड़ने के लिए 'and added that' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: 'have lost' को 'had lost' में बदलें। चरण 4: Pronouns (We->they, our->their, your->his/my) बदलें।
trick: Exclamatory वाक्य को हमेशा Assertive (Subject + Verb) रूप में बदलना आवश्यक है (it was a disaster)।
tip: Exclamatory + Assertive को 'and added that' से जोड़ें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The monk said, 'If a man conquers his own mind, he conquers the entire world.'
options: The monk said that if a man conquered his own mind, he conquered the entire world.
The monk preached that if a man conquers his own mind, he conquers the entire world.
The monk said that if a man had conquered his own mind, he would conquer the entire world.
The monk stated that if a man conquers his own mind, he will conquer the entire world.
answer: The monk preached that if a man conquers his own mind, he conquers the entire world.
explanation: चरण 1: यह वाक्य एक आध्यात्मिक/दार्शनिक सत्य (Universal Truth) है। चरण 2: ऐसे सत्यों का Tense Indirect Speech में कभी नहीं बदलता है, भले ही वे Conditional संरचना में हों। चरण 3: 'conquers' अपने Present रूप में ही रहेगा। चरण 4: 'preached' या 'stated' लिखकर 'that' से वाक्य को ज्यों का त्यों जोड़ दें।
trick: Conditional वाक्यों में भी यदि वे Universal Truth हैं, तो Tense परिवर्तन का नियम लागू नहीं होता।
tip: Universal Truth वाले Conditionals का Tense नहीं बदलता।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The CEO said to the board, 'Let us focus on innovation, for the market is becoming highly competitive.'
options: The CEO proposed to the board that they should focus on innovation, for the market was becoming highly competitive.
The CEO suggested to the board to focus on innovation because the market is becoming highly competitive.
The CEO proposed the board that we should focus on innovation, as the market was becoming highly competitive.
The CEO ordered the board that they should focus on innovation, for the market was becoming highly competitive.
answer: The CEO proposed to the board that they should focus on innovation, for the market was becoming highly competitive.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let us' को प्रस्ताव (Proposal) माना जाता है, इसलिए 'said to' को 'proposed to' में बदलें ('to' लगाना अनिवार्य है)। चरण 2: 'Let us' को हटाकर 'that they should' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 3: 'is becoming' को 'was becoming' में बदलें। चरण 4: 'for' (कंजंक्शन) को ज्यों का त्यों रखें।
trick: 'Proposed/Suggested' के बाद Object होने पर 'to' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है (proposed to the board)।
tip: 'Let us' को 'proposed/suggested to + Object + that they should' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Do you not feel ashamed of your conduct?' the teacher said to the boy. 'I will surely complain to your parents.'
options: The teacher asked the boy if he did not feel ashamed of his conduct and warned that she would surely complain to his parents.
The teacher asked the boy whether he does not feel ashamed of his conduct and added that she will surely complain to his parents.
The teacher enquired the boy if he did not feel ashamed of his conduct and threatened that she would surely complain to his parents.
The teacher asked the boy if he did not felt ashamed of his conduct and warned that she would surely complain to his parents.
answer: The teacher asked the boy if he did not feel ashamed of his conduct and warned that she would surely complain to his parents.
explanation: चरण 1: प्रश्नवाचक भाग के लिए 'asked if' का प्रयोग करें। 'Do you not feel' को 'he did not feel' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'will complain' एक चेतावनी (Warning) है। इसे 'and warned that she would complain' में बदलें। चरण 3: 'your' को 'his' में बदलें।
trick: 'did not' के साथ हमेशा V1 (feel) आता है। विकल्प D में 'did not felt' लिखा है, जो एक आम फँसाने वाला ट्रैप है।
tip: Interrogative + Assertive (Warning) को 'asked if... and warned that...' से जोड़ें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The passenger said, 'I had better cancel my flight tickets if the storm continues.'
options: The passenger said that he had better cancel his flight tickets if the storm continued.
The passenger said that he had better cancelled his flight tickets if the storm continued.
The passenger advised that he should cancel his flight tickets if the storm continued.
The passenger said that he had better cancel his flight tickets if the storm continues.
answer: The passenger said that he had better cancel his flight tickets if the storm continued.
explanation: चरण 1: 'had better' का रूप Indirect Speech में कभी नहीं बदलता है (यह 'had better + V1' ही रहता है)। चरण 2: 'I' को 'he' और 'my' को 'his' में बदलें। चरण 3: Conditional clause 'if the storm continues' (Present) को 'if the storm continued' (Past Indefinite) में बदलें।
trick: छात्र 'had better' को 'had better cancelled' में बदलने की कोशिश करते हैं, जो गलत है। 'continues' का Tense बदलना भी अनिवार्य है।
tip: 'Had better' का Tense Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Help! Help!' shouted the drowning man. 'I do not know how to swim.'
options: The drowning man shouted for help and cried that he did not know how to swim.
The drowning man shouted help help and said that he did not know how to swim.
The drowning man begged for help and said that he does not know how to swim.
The drowning man requested to help him and added that he did not know how to swim.
answer: The drowning man shouted for help and cried that he did not know how to swim.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Help! Help!' जैसे शब्दों को Reporting Verb के भाव में बदल दिया जाता है ('shouted for help')। चरण 2: दूसरे Assertive वाक्य को 'and cried that' या 'and added that' से जोड़ें। चरण 3: 'do not know' (Present) को 'did not know' (Past) में बदलें। चरण 4: 'I' को 'he' में बदलें।
trick: बार-बार दोहराए गए शब्दों (Help! Help!) को Indirect Speech में नहीं लिखा जाता, बल्कि उनके भाव (shouted for help) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
tip: दोहराए गए शब्दों को Reporting Verb के भाव (shouted for help) में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: She said, 'If I had the money, I would buy that antique clock immediately.'
options: She said that if she had the money, she would buy that antique clock immediately.
She said that if she had had the money, she would have bought that antique clock immediately.
She said that if she had the money, she will buy that antique clock immediately.
She said that if she has the money, she would buy that antique clock immediately.
answer: She said that if she had the money, she would buy that antique clock immediately.
explanation: चरण 1: यह Type 2 Conditional (Unreal Present/Improbable) है: 'If + Past Indefinite... would + V1'। 'had' यहाँ मुख्य क्रिया (V2) है। चरण 2: Unreal Conditionals का Tense Indirect Speech में कभी नहीं बदलता है। चरण 3: 'I' को 'she' में बदलें। चरण 4: वाक्य की संरचना पूर्णतः अपरिवर्तित रहेगी।
trick: Type 2 Conditional को Type 3 (had had / would have) में बदलना एक बहुत ही सामान्य त्रुटि है। Unreal Conditionals हमेशा अपरिवर्तित रहते हैं।
tip: Unreal Conditionals (Type 2 और 3) का Tense Indirect में नहीं बदलता।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Let me handle this negotiation,' the lawyer said to his client. 'I have dealt with such cases before.'
options: The lawyer proposed to his client that he should handle that negotiation as he had dealt with such cases before.
The lawyer requested his client to let him handle that negotiation and added that he had dealt with such cases before.
The lawyer told his client to let him handle this negotiation because he dealt with such cases before.
The lawyer asked his client to let him handle that negotiation since he has dealt with such cases before.
answer: The lawyer requested his client to let him handle that negotiation and added that he had dealt with such cases before.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let me' वाले वाक्यों में अनुमति/निवेदन (Request) होता है। 'said to' को 'requested' में बदलें। चरण 2: 'Let' को 'to let' में बदलें। 'this' को 'that' करें। चरण 3: दूसरे Assertive वाक्य को 'and added that' या 'as/because' से जोड़ें। चरण 4: 'have dealt' (Present Perfect) को 'had dealt' (Past Perfect) में बदलें।
trick: 'Let me' प्रस्ताव नहीं है, इसलिए 'proposed' गलत है। इसे 'to let him' में बदलना सबसे सटीक तरीका है।
tip: 'Let me' (अनुमति) को 'requested to let + pronoun' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The instructor said, 'Trainees, you must assemble in the courtyard by 5 AM, rain or shine.'
options: The instructor ordered the trainees that they had to assemble in the courtyard by 5 AM, rain or shine.
The instructor instructed the trainees that they must assemble in the courtyard by 5 AM, rain or shine.
The instructor told the trainees that they must have assembled in the courtyard by 5 AM, rain or shine.
The instructor commanded the trainees to assemble in the courtyard by 5 AM, rain or shine.
answer: The instructor commanded the trainees to assemble in the courtyard by 5 AM, rain or shine.
explanation: चरण 1: Vocative 'Trainees' को Object बनाएँ (commanded the trainees)। चरण 2: 'must' वाले Imperative आदेशों को सीधे 'to + V1' (to assemble) से जोड़ना सबसे उत्कृष्ट और संक्षिप्त तरीका है। चरण 3: 'You must' को हटा दें क्योंकि आदेश (command) में कर्ता स्वतः स्पष्ट होता है। चरण 4: 'rain or shine' एक idiom है जो अपरिवर्तित रहेगा।
trick: 'ordered/commanded + Object + to V1' संरचना 'You must' वाले आदेशों के लिए सबसे मानक मानी जाती है (बजाय that they had to के)।
tip: सख्त आदेशों (You must) को 'commanded + Object + to V1' में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Damn the torpedoes!' the admiral shouted. 'Full speed ahead!'
options: The admiral shouted cursing the torpedoes and ordered full speed ahead.
The admiral cursed the torpedoes and ordered to go full speed ahead.
The admiral exclaimed with a curse upon the torpedoes and commanded full speed ahead.
All of the above are acceptable narrative transformations capturing the emotional imperative.
answer: All of the above are acceptable narrative transformations capturing the emotional imperative.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Damn the...' को 'cursed the' या 'shouted cursing' या 'exclaimed with a curse' में बदला जा सकता है। चरण 2: 'Full speed ahead!' एक बिना क्रिया का आदेश (Elliptical Imperative) है। चरण 3: इसे 'ordered full speed ahead' या 'commanded full speed ahead' में भावार्थ के अनुसार बदला जाता है। चरण 4: सभी विकल्प उन्नत व्याकरण के अनुसार सही हैं।
trick: साहित्यिक या भावनात्मक वाक्यों (Elliptical clauses) का कोई एक कठोर नियम नहीं होता, उन्हें भावार्थ (Sense) के आधार पर बदला जाता है।
tip: अपशब्दों और अधूरे वाक्यों को Reporting Verb के भावार्थ में बदलें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: He said to me, 'Let us not dig up the past. What is done cannot be undone.'
options: He proposed to me that we should not dig up the past, adding that what was done could not be undone.
He suggested to me that they should not dig up the past, and said that what is done cannot be undone.
He proposed to me that we should not dig up the past, adding that what is done cannot be undone.
He ordered me not to dig up the past because what was done could not be undone.
answer: He proposed to me that we should not dig up the past, adding that what is done cannot be undone.
explanation: चरण 1: 'Let us' को 'proposed to' में बदलें। चूँकि Object 'me' है, 'we should not' का प्रयोग करें। चरण 2: 'What is done cannot be undone' एक Proverb (कहावत) है। चरण 3: कहावतों का Tense Indirect Speech में कभी नहीं बदलता है। चरण 4: अतः दूसरे भाग को 'and added that what is done cannot be undone' ज्यों का त्यों रखें।
trick: छात्र पहले भाग को सही कर लेते हैं लेकिन कहावत (Proverb) वाले दूसरे भाग का Tense (was done could not) बदल देते हैं, जो गलत है।
tip: कहावतों (Proverbs) का Tense Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: 'Who are you to question my authority?' the dictator snarled at the reporter. 'I am the absolute ruler here.'
options: The dictator snarled at the reporter asking who he was to question his authority and declared that he was the absolute ruler there.
The dictator asked the reporter angrily who was he to question his authority and said that he was the absolute ruler here.
The dictator snarled at the reporter who he was to question his authority and declared that he is the absolute ruler there.
The dictator asked the reporter who he had been to question his authority and stated that he was the absolute ruler there.
answer: The dictator snarled at the reporter asking who he was to question his authority and declared that he was the absolute ruler there.
explanation: चरण 1: 'snarled' के साथ प्रश्न होने पर 'snarled at the reporter asking' का प्रयोग उचित है। चरण 2: 'who are you' को Assertive क्रम 'who he was' में बदलें। 'my' को 'his' करें। चरण 3: 'I am' को 'he was' और 'here' को 'there' में बदलें। चरण 4: घमंड भरी बात के लिए 'declared that' का प्रयोग करें।
trick: Indirect Question में Inversion (Verb + Subject) का प्रयोग नहीं होता। 'who was he' गलत है, 'who he was' सही है। 'Here' का 'there' करना न भूलें।
tip: Indirect Question में हमेशा S + V का क्रम (Assertive) रखें।

question: Identify the correct indirect speech transformation: The monk said, 'You need not carry the burden of your past mistakes. Forgiveness is always available.'
options: The monk told me that I did not need to carry the burden of my past mistakes as forgiveness was always available.
The monk advised that one need not carry the burden of one's past mistakes, for forgiveness is always available.
The monk said that I need not have carried the burden of my past mistakes because forgiveness was always available.
The monk told that you would not have to carry the burden of your past mistakes as forgiveness is always available.
answer: The monk advised that one need not carry the burden of one's past mistakes, for forgiveness is always available.
explanation: चरण 1: यह एक आध्यात्मिक उपदेश है। 'You' यहाँ सामान्य मनुष्य (One/People) के लिए प्रयुक्त हुआ है। चरण 2: 'need not' (वर्तमान/सार्वभौमिक सत्य की तरह) अपरिवर्तित रहेगा। चरण 3: 'Forgiveness is...' भी एक सार्वभौमिक दार्शनिक तथ्य है, अतः 'is' नहीं बदलेगा। चरण 4: 'You' को 'one' और 'your' को 'one's' में बदलना उच्च स्तरीय व्याकरण है।
trick: दार्शनिक उपदेशों में 'You' को अक्सर 'One' (कोई भी व्यक्ति) में बदला जाता है और Tense अपरिवर्तित रखा जाता है क्योंकि वे सार्वभौमिक सत्य होते हैं।
tip: सार्वभौमिक उपदेशों में 'You' को 'One' मानें और Tense न बदलें।
